links.outcome: Reading level of LLM responses (FRE, FKGL) for prenatal screening FAQs
links.effect: Mean FRE 20.11 (ChatGPT-4o) and 32.25 (Gemini); mean FKGL 15.09 and 12.64, respectively; differences significant (P = 0.001, P = 0.002).
links.quote: The mean FRE scores were 20.11 for ChatGPT-4o and 32.25 for Gemini Advanced 1.5 Pro, and the mean FKGL scores were 15.09 and 12.64, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses (ChatGPT-4o and Gemini Advanced 1.5 Pro) to prenatal screening FAQs for accuracy, readability, and guideline adherence without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
